description: Step-by-step derivation of n (neutron, A=1)'s archimedean Markov trace value tr_M(n, q_0) ≈ 1.5893934459539052 from the seven first-principles entrypoints.  Per the methodology directive (post-#472), every numerical claim must trace back here.  SCRIPT_CITED steps are the computational frontier; each needs its own derivation chain to push back the frontier.

steps.name: Hecke algebra H_3(q) presentation
steps.operation: Define H_3(q) := ⟨σ_1..σ_2 | braid relations, Hecke relation (σ_i - q)(σ_i + q^{-1}) = 0⟩.
steps.notes: Hecke energy axiom: each σ_i carries σ_i^2 = (q-q^{-1})σ_i + 1; the (q-q^{-1}) factor is the per-crossing energy (AGENTS.md §7a).

steps.name: Wedderburn decomposition of H_3(q)
steps.operation: H_3(q) ≅ ⊕_{λ ⊢ 3} M_{f_λ}(K(q)) (semisimple at generic q, including q_0).
steps.notes: Partitions of 3 index the simple factors; Hoefsmit frame dimensions f_λ from `schur_weyl_symbolic.partitions_of`.  Mathlib backs the abstract direct-sum statement via `Algebra.Algebraic.Module.WedderburnArtin`.

steps.name: Schur–Weyl weights w_λ(q)
steps.operation: For each λ, compute w_λ(q) per Schur–Weyl duality U_q(sl_2) ↺ V^{⊗3A}; Hoefsmit normalisation (Kassel §III.4).
steps.notes: script: computations/schur_weyl_symbolic.py function `schur_weyl_weight(lam, q)`.  SCRIPT_CITED pending its own derivation chain.

steps.name: Categorical action B_3 → ⊕_λ M_{f_λ}
steps.operation: Categorical action of B_3 on V^{⊗3A} via the R-matrix; project to each λ-block to get ρ^λ : H → M_{f_λ}(K(q)).
steps.output_value: ρ^λ for each λ — see hecke_character_symbolic.py
steps.notes: script: computations/hecke/hecke_character_symbolic.py Hoefsmit-matrix evaluation of σ_i.  SCRIPT_CITED.

steps.name: Atomic n braid word T_w(Z=0, N=1)
steps.operation: Atomic braid recipe: Z=0 up-strands, N=1 down-strands, include_inter=False; produces a word with 5 crossings on 3 strands.
steps.notes: script: computations/hecke/hecke_character_symbolic.py function `atomic_braid_to_crossings`.  SCRIPT_CITED — the atomic-braid recipe itself awaits formalisation.

steps.name: Frobenius pairing — characters χ^λ_q(T_w)
steps.operation: For each λ, compute χ^λ_q(T_w) := tr(ρ^λ(T_w)) (Frobenius pairing identifies traces with characters of the regular rep).
steps.output_value: χ^λ_q(T_w) Laurent polynomial in q for each λ ⊢ 3

steps.name: Markov trace via finite-Jones formula
steps.operation: tr_M(T_w, q) := Σ_{λ ⊢ 3} w_λ(q) · χ^λ_q(T_w); uniqueness from the Markov property + finite-Jones.
steps.output_value: symbolic Laurent polynomial in q (Markov trace)
steps.notes: Derivation chain: markov-trace-assembly-neutron.derivation.json. Combines schur-weyl-weight-{3,21,111} + hoefsmit-rep-21-{sigma1,sigma2}. The CANONICAL neutron σ-word is derived in atomic-braid-recipe-n.derivation.json (11 crossings = 5 σ + 4 σ^{-1} + 2 averaged).  The assembly chain's chi-step operations use a SEPARATE LEGACY 5-letter σ-word convention (T_w_n = σ_1 σ_1^{-1} σ_2 σ_1 σ_2^{-1}, n_+=3, n_-=2); the two conventions yield symbolically different χ^λ values.  The leaf value at q_0 here is anchored against TR_M_AT_Q0, which markov_trace_symbolic computes via the canonical convention; reconciling the assembly chain's symbolic chi steps with the canonical convention is open frontier.

steps.name: Evaluate tr_M(n, q_0) at q_0 = 1.1099785955541805
steps.operation: Substitute q := q_0 = 1.1099785955541805 into `tr_M_symbolic` and evaluate at high precision (mpmath, 60 dps).
steps.notes: COMPUTATIONAL leaf — numerical eval.  Cross-checked at machine precision against atomic-poly evaluation, the Vandermonde-interpolation pipeline, and (when claude/continue-pr-442-DJRWm lands) the Mittag-Leffler residue path.  All paths agree at rel_diff ≤ 1e-12.
